summary: In 2014, then in the Alaska House, Kreiss-Tomkins voted for a resolution commending the State of Israel, which passed with no votes against. His 2026 Alaska gubernatorial campaign platform addresses education, housing, energy, healthcare, data-center regulation, and government ethics without referencing Israel, Palestine, Gaza, or Middle East policy. That single recorded pro-Israel legislative vote is the only documented action bearing on his position toward Palestinian justice.
